title: Rate-One Post-Quantum AEAD from qPRPs
summary: LRW gives a rate-one tweakable block cipher from a PRP classically, but constructing a rate-one post-quantum AEAD using only qPRP security remains open.

formal_statement.body: The unresolved problem is whether it is possible to construct a post-quantum authenticated-encryption-with-associated-data (AEAD) scheme of rate one from a block cipher under only a quantum-secure pseudorandom-permutation (qPRP) assumption. The supplied comparison states that the LRW construction gives a rate-one tweakable block cipher (TBC), meaning one block-cipher call per TBC call, from a PRP assumption, whereas the construction called Ours requires related-key security for its underlying block cipher; it also says that the LRW approach does not seem applicable to the post-quantum setting. The task is therefore to determine whether such a rate-one post-quantum AEAD can be built with qPRP security alone.

scope.domain: Post-quantum authenticated encryption constructed from block ciphers.
assumptions: Only quantum-secure pseudorandom-permutation (qPRP) security for the underlying block cipher.
parameters: Rate one: the required efficiency of the target post-quantum AEAD
scope.unresolved_remainder: Whether a rate-one post-quantum AEAD can be constructed from a block cipher under qPRP security alone.

progress.summary: The source contrasts LRW's classical rate-one TBC from a PRP with its own reliance on related-key security and says LRW does not seem applicable post-quantum. It then explicitly asks for a qPRP-only rate-one post-quantum AEAD.
citation_labels: Ritam Bhaumik et al., QCB: Efficient Quantum-secure Authenticated Encryption
